purpose: Every modification made to the pinned official source tree while producing the local unsigned runner. The upstream directory was extracted from a GitHub API tarball and has no git metadata, so this manifest is the authoritative change record.

patches.summary: applyInstanceUserData() reads DSH_DESKTOP_USER_DATA (absolute path required) and calls app.setPath('userData', resolve(...)) before claimDesktopSingleInstance, so each Hub instance owns a distinct Electron userData root and therefore a distinct single-instance lock.
desktopPort() reads DSH_DESKTOP_PORT (default 19387, validates integer 1..65535) and the host is started with --no-open --port <port>, so each Hub instance binds its own loopback port.

Non-secret localhost build metadata required by the official packaging environment loader (app id, test deployment, localhost policy/download origins, random 32-hex test release id, signature cache concurrency 1). Contains no signing or upload credentials.

patches.reason: Upstream packaging gap: @deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol/lib/index.js imports '@deepseek-ai/cordis' but packages/typert/protocol/package.json declares only @deepseek-ai/dsh-brand as a production dependency (cordis is linked in the monorepo outside production scope). electron-builder collects production dependencies only, so the packaged app.asar/node_modules contained 7 @deepseek-ai packages including dsh-brand and cosmokit but not cordis. The Electron main process then aborts at startup with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/cordis', surfaced as a native 'Error' dialog reading 'A JavaScript error occurred in the main process'. ESM resolution ignores NODE_PATH, so the package must be inside app.asar/node_modules.
patches.evidence: UI Automation read of the runner's startup error dialog; asar listing of runtimes/0.1.7-alpha.1/resources/app.asar
patches.reversible: Remove the single dependencies entry and rebuild.

patches.summary: Lockfile updated by 'pnpm install --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop --no-frozen-lockfile' (+1 package) so the workspace link apps/desktop/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/cordis -> vendor/cordis exists and electron-builder can collect it.
patches.reason: CI=1 makes frozen-lockfile the default, so the dependency addition was rejected with ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE until the lockfile was synced.
patches.reversible: Restore the pinned tarball's original pnpm-lock.yaml and remove the dependencies entry.
